name: ArisInfra Solutions Ltd
title: ArisInfra Solutions Ltd - 544419 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Asset-light materials platform: Contract Manufacturing utilisation 39%→50% YoY and FY26 revenue +39% to INR 1,068 cr, but Q4 EBITDA was flattered by a non-cash INR 5 cr unwinding gain and a INR 5 cr extra ECL, and PAT came off a low base.

utilisation.quote: We also saw capacity utilization improvement to 50% from 39% in the corresponding quarter last year

triggers.label: Utilisation 39% → 50% YoY
triggers.quote: capacity utilization improvement to 50% from 39% in the corresponding quarter last year

triggers.label: Q1 to lock 85-90% of FY27 top line
triggers.quote: our aim is in Q1, we should be able to predict around 85% to 90% of our top line

triggers.label: Non-cash INR 5 cr gain flatters EBITDA
triggers.quote: there was about a INR 5 crore of non-cash unwinding income recognized during the period, which has resulted in higher other income

triggers.label: Working capital days 110 → 66
triggers.quote: The net working capital days further reduced to 66 days in FY26 from 110 days a year ago

guidance.quote: the projected revenue growth is about 35% to 40%
we would maintain an EBITDA of around 10 % to 10.5%
we will be looking to reach a peak utilization of more than 75% to 80% in this financial year itself

guidance.metric: Operating cash flow to PAT ratio
guidance.quote: the next year we will be looking to be somewhere around 1 :1.5 maybe

red_flags.label: Q4 EBITDA helped by non-cash INR 5 cr unwinding income
red_flags.quote: there was about a INR 5 crore of non-cash unwinding income recognized during the period, which has resulted in higher other income

red_flags.label: Interest cost rising as working-capital debt added
red_flags.quote: We got a INR 30 crores sanction from one of the banks

red_flags.label: Stuck receivables INR 40-42 cr over 180 days
red_flags.quote: the stuck receivables, now are in the range of about INR 40 crores, INR 42 crores

red_flags.label: Contract manufacturing capacity locked by trade deposits
red_flags.quote: currently the trade deposits that are deployed for securing the capacity
